description: This file defines an interface `AdapterProvider` which provides a method to retrieve a list of `Adapter` objects. It serves as an abstraction for any class that acts as a provider of adapters, typically representing a component that manages or supplies adapters of a particular type.

classes.name: AdapterProvider
classes.description: Interface for a provider of adapters, defining a method to retrieve all associated adapters.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns a list of all adapters managed or provided by this provider.
